crossRefs.note: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.
On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.
Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea…
Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body…
For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…

translations.web: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
translations.bsb: After the men had eaten their fill, they lightened the ship by throwing the grain into the sea.
translations.kjv: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.
translations.asv: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
